name: s81hc_cryyw_ref

job.purpose: [hc-crooty] crooty v3 2-tile split, C=0: y slice tile (far side, above crrf): y_s -> yp -> yp2 -> SRAM FWFT FIFO (11 x 128x256 in 3 columns 3/4/4) -> p_y; ~14.1k flops on its own root; replaces s81hc_crootyw_ref-v2 (one root over 18.4k flops + 11 macros, hold repair not converging) | v4: clock/reset/control pins moved from the SW corner to the E edge channel (v3 EARLY_FAIL_CONGESTION GRT-0116: 11 V gcells in the W edge channel x 2-20 um; hook OT_GRT_TOP_SHADOW ran, hotspot neither over macros nor at the y pins). | v5 (third congestion failure, GRT-0116 x3): 11-macro plan re-cut from 4/4/3 to 3/4/4 columns -- the W column, whose single edge channel (22.5 um, no second side to spill to) overflowed in v3 and v4, now carries 3 macros (FIFO slices 0-2 at y 32.4 / 129.6 / 224.64, row channels 54-56 um) instead of 4; slices 3-6 are column 1 and 7-10 column 2, which also lines each column up with its own y_s / p_y pin span (slice k pins at x 2.2 + 33.2 k). Cut analysis: the V cut beside the bottom W macro carried 3 x 256 descending rd_out + 137 wd_in = 905 nets against ~790 derated M3+M5 tracks (1,081 raw in 22.5 um); now 2 x 256 + 137 = 649. Plus the 6.0 um M5 no-entry strip inside both vertical edges of every macro (physical/s81_hc_pinplan/cryy_sram_edge_strip.tcl): M5 over an SRAM is N-S pass-through only, so GRT no longer books pin access on tracks that end on M4 OBS. Outline, slot, pins and RTL unchanged.
